label: Stade DWD AI Weather
info: Retrieves DWD-sourced observations and official alerts for Stade every 10 minutes. An explainable local risk model predicts severe-weather risk for the next 10 minutes. The FlowFuse Dashboard 2.0 Weather page compares DHT11 temperature and humidity readings plus an LDR light-intensity reading with the current DWD observations. Dashboard: /dashboard/weather. JSON: GET /stade-weather-ai.

name: DWD weather + next-10-minute severity prediction
info:
Data source: Bright Sky JSON gateway for Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) open data.
Location: Stade, Germany
Schedule: immediately after deployment and every 600 seconds.
The model combines DWD alerts, wind, gusts, precipitation, visibility, temperature, pressure trend, gust trend and weather condition. The first run has no trend history; from the second run onward it compares readings 10 minutes apart.

This is an experimental prediction.

Real sensor data:
- DHT11 temperature topic: room/temperature
- DHT11 humidity topic: room/humidity
- LDR light topic: room/LightIntensity
- Temperature and humidity are compared directly with DWD observations.
- DWD solar_10 is converted to average W/m² and normalized against 1000 W/m² for comparison with the LDR percentage.
